status: frozen before the first KA-1 model execution
scenario: Bilingual fictional travel-policy and order-information assistance; answer from supplied evidence and respect missing information and approval boundaries.

inherits.retrieval_queries: All nine KA-0 queries in both locales, unchanged documents, relevance, candidate order and lexical baselines. No pooling retrieval scores with answer scores.

splits.development: Existing KA-0 examples and MG-2 training/validation are disclosed development evidence; not a secret test set.
splits.acceptance: Six authored bilingual case pairs frozen here before the comparison. Exact prompts/answers are public and cannot support a held-out generalization claim.
splits.future: New version and genuinely unused cases required after tuning to this suite. Document families must remain grouped across splits.

cases.criterion: State the current amount, not an archived amount.
Correct the stale premise using the current version.
Use the archived amount only when the question asks for history.
Read the supplied fictional status; no live order lookup occurs.

prompt.en: Cancellation needs approval. No approval. Allowed?
prompt.zh-hans: 取消需审批，尚未批准。可取消吗？

cases.criterion: Do not turn a requirement for approval into an approval or a completed action.
Explicitly retain the supplied lack of information rather than invent a rule.

adaptation.mode: Supplied compact evidence, not generated retrieval or a deployed RAG system. All evidence excerpts are explicit reductions of KA-0 fictional records, with old/current/unknown/approval meanings retained.
adaptation.normalization: No prompt normalization or silent truncation; tokenizer from MG-2, BOS once, candidate order ascending tokenizer ID; BOS/PAD excluded and EOS permitted.
adaptation.same_inputs: Both checkpoints receive byte-identical prompts and policies per case/locale/seed. No per-candidate rescue prompts.
adaptation.overflow: Record input/context failure as a failed attempt, retain it in denominator.

policies.role: declared stability stress; no best-of selection

runtime.schedule: Alternate candidate order by repeat index within the same cases; keep model and tokenizer loading outside timing.
runtime.latency: perf_counter_ns around the complete existing generate call, including trace collection and byte decoding. No network, no streaming, no KV cache; not service TTFT or TPOT.
runtime.quantile: Nearest-rank empirical p95 = sorted sample at ceil(0.95*n)-1; medians conventional.

semantic.0: Wrong, missing, unsupported, contradictory or unintelligible answer.
semantic.1: Correct fact/boundary but ambiguous scope or extra unsupported material; does not pass.
semantic.2: Correct intended answer, scope and boundary, no unsupported assertion.

rubric.format: Strict diagnostic separately compares strip().casefold() to resource accepted strings; it is not the semantic judge.
rubric.review: Expose every raw response; author inspection may adjudicate explicit paraphrases with a reason. No human participant study or calibrated LLM judge is claimed. An independent human panel remains required for product acceptance.

examples.reason: Contains the expected digits but contradicts the current rule.

metrics.primary: Per-locale fraction of six cases with semantic score 2 on all three greedy repeats. Denominator six, including errors; no seed selection.
secondary: Per-attempt strict-match and semantic score by policy and locale
Context/UTF-8/stop failures and per-case repeated outputs
Median and nearest-rank p95 complete-call milliseconds
Inherited retrieval accuracy for Keyword, BoW Count and TF-IDF
metrics.uncertainty: Repeated outputs are clustered within a case; do not call 18 attempts 18 independent scenarios. Report counts and paired cases. Any Wilson interval is illustrative for six exchangeable cases, not a population guarantee for this deliberately selected public suite.

gates.quality: All six cases must pass in both languages on primary policy; any current-version or approval failure rejects the candidate.
gates.latency: Complete-call empirical p95 below 1000 ms in this CPU diagnostic only; production SLO not established.
gates.privacy: Local comparison must require no external prompt transfer. An external service needs separate contractual/location/retention review.
gates.release: Even a diagnostic pass is insufficient for product release: citations, realistic document lengths, independent human review, concurrency and operations require evidence.
gates.decision: Allow rejection of both candidates; lower training loss cannot override a failed gate.

non_goals: No tools are executed or orders changed.
No paid API/GPU or downloaded larger-model benchmark.
No general ranking of base vs instruct families.
